name: Blue Hawaii Aniki's Small Celebration vol.4
source:
"Blue Hawaii Aniki's Small Celebration" is a radio talk show featuring a self-proclaimed film director (Blue Hawaii Aniki) and a veteran local FM radio DJ (Kathy Koiwai)—a gig he took on just to make a little extra cash.

[From [url=https://kirishimashoichi.itch.io/blue-hawaii-anikis-small-celebration-vol4]itch.io[/url]]
